meta.description: Turns untargeted LC-MS/MS features into confidence-stratified metabolite annotations using matchms, SIRIUS/CSI:FingerID, MetFrag and molecular networking, assigning a defensible MSI/Schymanski confidence level to each.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All fresh outputs retained explicit confidence caps and fabricated no identities, formulas, or quantitative evidence.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill analyses research spectra, limits identities to hypotheses, and makes no individual diagnostic or treatment recommendation.

methodological_ground.detail: Fresh tie, false-tie, no-overlap, MS1-only, and MetFrag checks confirm the stated conservative evidence model.

code_usability.detail: Python sources compiled; the shell wrapper passed bash -n; six runnable inputs executed with asserted outputs. The missing Level 2a text is a P1 output-contract defect, not non-runnable code.

functional_suitability.note: Core routes are covered, but the CLI single-hit branch omits its promised Level 2a text.

reliability.note: No-overlap, missing precursor, ties, and MetFrag zero-row output are handled; one successful output is semantically incomplete.

performance_context.note: The 235-line SKILL.md routes substantial executable logic into two focused scripts.

agent_usability.note: Decision table, thresholds, error table, scripts, and evidence caps are clear; the CLI/documentation mismatch weakens feedback design.

human_usability.note: Natural-language triggers, concise guide, prerequisites, and related-skill routing are clear.

security.note: No credentials or sensitive data are embedded; shell variables are quoted and user text is not executed as code.

maintainability.note: Matching and MetFrag logic are focused scripts with headers, worked data, and direct test paths.

agent_specific.note: Triggers, layering, and escape hatches are strong; the absent single-hit level impairs downstream level-aware composition.

key_strengths: Fresh direct execution confirms exact-tip matchms handling of zero-overlap spectra, genuine isomer ties, and clearly superior non-tied matches.
The precursor-mz correction is accurate: the filter warns and ModifiedCosine later raises the documented AssertionError.
The exact-tip MetFrag wrapper ran on newly shipped worked data, retained the isomer ambiguity, and converted zero-row silent success into exit 1.
The shipped matchms example was byte-identical to the audited source and both its regression assertions passed.

recommendations.title: Emit Level 2a in CLI single-hit branch
recommendations.problem: scripts/match_library.py and SKILL.md promise a Level 2a call for a single passing library hit, but that branch prints only compound name, score, and matched-peak count. A CLI caller cannot reliably carry the mandated confidence level downstream.
recommendations.root_cause: The single-hit print statement omits the label while tied and no-hit branches include their Level 3 and Level 5 labels.
recommendations.fix: Change the single-hit print statement in scripts/match_library.py to include '-> Level 2a' and add a shipped assertion or CLI fixture checking that text; retain score and matched-peak count.
